deadline_contract.clock: monotonic only within matching boot_id; wall clock reporting only

examples.result: PASS remains; original DELIVERY_UNKNOWN remains; separate later-delivered evidence may be reported
HOLD remains; no journal append; follow-up evidence only

late_receipt_rule.after_SUPERVISOR_CLOSED: cannot append to the closed canonical journal
late_receipt_rule.operator_view: may show original closeout outcome plus later observed delivery as separate timestamped evidence
storage_options: notification-plane follow-up evidence bound to transaction and original notification_id

submission_idempotency.recovery: query the existing adapter/request identity when possible; never blind-resend after ambiguous submission
submission_idempotency.request_event: NOTIFICATION_REQUESTED must bind deterministic notification_id and payload digest before submission
